A '''Human''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] scout had [[Color/Legends|light brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. On one occasion, they looked at a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] map with another [[Unidentified hyperspace scout 1|hyperspace scout]] while wearing a gray [[shirt]] and a brown jacket.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh, and Chris Trevas was kind enough to not only supply gorgeous illustrations throughout the book, but he used me and Dan as models for two hyperspace scouts. So I guess we're part of continuity ourselves now. When do we get to be action figures?|Jason Fry|<ref name="Gelf">{{WebCite|url=http://www.gelfmagazine.com/archives/mapping_the_galaxy_of_far_far_away.php|text=Mapping the Galaxy of Far, Far Away|author=Michael Gluckstadt|date=2010-01-14|archivedate=20130430131834}}</ref>}}
The Human hyperspace scout was first mentioned in a caption for a picture illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="TEA" /> This scout is an [[in-universe]] drawing of one of the co-authors, Daniel Wallace.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|111|Blaster}}</ref> The picture that contains this scout also contains a drawing of the other half of the co-authorship, Jason Fry. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] included in the picture translates into "Unknown."<ref name="TEA" />
